title: Seed Formats
description: Defines how seeds are encoded - word lists, hex, QR - balancing human usability against density. Good formats are unambiguous to read aloud and hard to mistype.

title: Deterministic Derivation
description: Derives unlimited keys from one seed through a one-way hierarchy, so backing up the seed backs up everything. Deterministic derivation is why a 12-word phrase can secure an entire wallet.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Seed Distribution
description: Moves seeds to where they are needed through secure channels - QR codes, encrypted files, in-person - without ever exposing them to networks unnecessarily. Distribution is the riskiest seed moment.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Replication Protocols
description: Defines how seeds replicate across sites - encrypted, authenticated, audited - so disaster recovery never waits on a single copy. Protocols make replication routine instead of heroic.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Integrity Checks
description: Verifies seed integrity on every use with checksums and test derivations, catching corruption before it causes wrong keys. Checks turn silent bit-rot into a maintenance event.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Seed Vaults
description: Stores seeds in hardened vaults - HSMs, safes, split locations - with access controls and audit trails. Vaults protect the root of trust with physical and cryptographic layers.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Hierarchical Seeds
description: Organizes seeds in a hierarchy - master, departmental, project - so compromise at one level does not expose the others. Hierarchies mirror organizational trust boundaries.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Recovery Phrases
description: Encodes seeds as memorable word sequences users can write down and store physically. Recovery phrases are the human interface to cryptographic roots of trust.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Seed Rotation
description: Rotates seeds on a schedule or after incidents, re-deriving and redistributing everything downstream. Rotation bounds the damage of any undetected seed compromise.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Air-Gapped Handling
description: Keeps master seeds on machines that never touch a network, with data crossing the gap only via QR codes or USB under supervision. Air gaps are the strongest practical defense for root seeds.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Multi-Party Seeds
description: Generates seeds through multi-party computation so no single party ever knows the whole seed. Multi-party generation removes the trusted-dealer problem from seed creation.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Seed Health Checks
description: Periodically verifies that seed backups are readable and correct - test restores without exposing seeds - so recovery works when needed. Health checks prevent the tragedy of discovering a bad backup during a disaster.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Bootstrap Sequences
description: Defines the exact order - seed, derive, verify, activate - for bringing a new system from nothing to trusted. Sequences make bootstrapping repeatable instead of tribal knowledge.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Versioned Seeds
description: Versions seed formats so future software can still read old seeds, with migration paths between versions. Versioning protects decades-long data against format obsolescence.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Audit Logs
description: Logs every seed operation - generation, access, rotation, destruction - in tamper-evident storage. Audit logs prove proper handling to regulators and investigators.
